title: Tourist Season, 2018 · the next day
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The day after Wood signs the parody 'Drift Wood': the tourist back, having looked it up, saying that's not his name. Wood says it's the strip's. The tourist wants it signed again with the real one. Wood signs it 'Drift Wood' again, smaller, underneath.

panels.composition: The seawall. A TOURIST with a printed parody strip, signed. WOOD on the bench. The PUP under it.

balloons.text: That's not your name. I looked.

razor-sharp brush and ink, a thin man on a bench answering mildly

panels.composition: The TOURIST holding out the pen again.

balloons.text: Sign it with the real one.
